experiment: Replace the original-target RF in the three-model ensemble with published log-target RF plus time/risk
ridge: Reuse the previously inner-selected Ridge from nested_tuning for each outer partition; no new Ridge search.
hgb: Reuse exact audited nested HGB inner OOF and matching outer predictions; no global OOF inputs to meta-training.
risk: Use the identical published cross-fitted risk procedure: 3-fold risk OOF entirely within each regression fitting partition plus a risk classifier fitted on that partition for scoring. Verified matching nested_hgb inner risk caches and HGB reference outer risk caches may be reused; record hash and partition provenance before use.
ensembles: Equal mean of Ridge, RF log-target plus time/risk, and HGB
Constrained MAE weights for Ridge, RF log-target plus time/risk, and HGB
combiner: Nonnegative weights summing to one, zero intercept, fitted on matching inner OOF only.
evaluation: Same sorted training orders and KFold(shuffle=True, random_state=33): outer5 and inner3. The RF specification is frozen; no parameter search. Refit it on each outer training partition. Compare mean outer MAE/RMSE and paired changes with HGB, prior three-model stack, and HGB/ExtraTrees stack.
holdout_policy: Do not load, predict or score test data. No final full-training deployment refit.
limitations: RF and HGB specifications were previously chosen using these development folds; this is retrospective development, not new independent confirmation.
Only RF is changed; Ridge remains the earlier inner-selected variant to preserve the controlled comparison.
Random folds assess the historical order mixture rather than future periods or unseen sellers.
